source_and_technical_evaluation: source_fidelity is assessed once against source truth; technical is assessed once from candidate.
palette_tone_aggregation: per reference: max(overall_palette,skin_treatment,hair_treatment,clothing_treatment) across observable regions; ensemble: component-wise median of per-reference primary losses
conditional_typography_dialogue: authorized exact-text probes only; separately record typography style, spelling adherence, single-instance adherence, and absence of unrequested text
history_comparability: Ensemble-v1 losses are not numerically comparable with singleton style-inversion-v3 history.
